job.title: Cultural Liaison Officer-Alice Springs
job.description:

* This is an Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Identified position *

This is a fantastic opportunity to make a meaningful difference in the lives of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander families and young people, supporting strong connections to culture, family, community and Country.

  • Provide cultural advice and guidance to support culturally safe service delivery.
  • Develop and implement Cultural Support Plans for children and young people.
  • Support and coordinate Return-to-Country visits and cultural activities.
  • Build strong relationships with Elders, families, communities and cultural organisations.
  • Provide cultural awareness training, mentoring and guidance to staff.
  • Advocate for cultural identity, connection to Country and community belonging.
  • Support Indigenous employment, traineeships and development opportunities.

  • Identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander.
  • Strong understanding of Aboriginal cultures, communities and protocols across Central Australia and the Northern Territory.
  • Previous experience in community services, youth services, disability, Out of Home Care or similar.
  • Experience developing Cultural Support Plans or similar documentation.
  • Excellent communication, relationship-building and community engagement skills.
  • Experience providing cultural guidance, mentoring or staff support.
  • Ability and willingness to travel to remote communities.
  • Current NT Driver Licence, Ochre Card, National Police Check, NDIS Worker Screening Clearance, NDIS Worker Orientation, First Aid and CPR certificates.

Experience in trauma-informed practice, cultural safety training and knowledge of the NDIS or Out of Home Care sector will be highly regarded.

Benefits:

  • Meaningful opportunity to support Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander children and families.
  • Alice Springs-based role with community engagement across Central Australia.

  • Make a positive impact on cultural connection, identity and belonging.
